# Alasdair MacIntyre

*1929 – 2025 · Scottish · [Aristotelianism](../movements/aristotelianism.md)*

Scottish philosopher who argues that modern morality, cut off from the traditions and communities that gave the virtues their meaning, survives only in fragments, and who calls for a return to [Aristotle](../philosophers/aristotle.md)'s ethics.
